author: Matthew Gilliam
message:
feat(m2): wire front-matter, page meta, and assets into Build.run

- Config.Site gains static_dir field (default: "static")
- Build.run: calls FrontMatter.split, Page.decode, skips draft pages,
  uses meta.title for <title>, calls Assets.copy after building pages
- Ssg.parse_args: adds --static-dir flag
- Uses helper fns (front_matter_yaml/body, Page.meta_draft/title) to
  extract primitives before the MdBlock pipeline to avoid RC underflow
